name: Baird's Hoard
purpose: Shows a live HDMI capture or a selected monitor in the opt-in Windows monitor profile. Saves screenshots, recent clips and pausable MP4 recordings. Assistants can list available sources, prepare a choice, look at the live picture and guide the person. The person turns on a local display in Baird.
notes: source_list reports the current mode and available monitor identities. source_select prepares a source and returns an undo token on changes. The person enables the selected local screen using its switch in Baird Settings. Live agent calls return source_off while the selected screen is off. Revocation discards pending snapshots and copilot looks. Capture and copilot tools can check a requested source. screen_look returns an image and saves a screenshot unless save=false. record_start, record_pause, record_resume and record_stop save the active spans as MP4. The monitor profile offers system audio and an optional microphone track. Saved media is available through media_list and media_look. HDMI requires the capture card driver. The shared selector, privacy policy and desktop overlay have separate integration work.
